description:
Watch the drama. Make your choice. Shape what happens next.

Orbittoon is a cinematic interactive drama app where every decision can change relationships, reveal hidden truths, unlock new scenes, and lead to a different ending.

Featured Drama: Moon Rain

Moon Rain is a choice-driven mystery romance where love, memory, secrets, and danger collide.

Play as Nira, a young woman returning to a world shaped by old memories, powerful families, hidden motives, and a tragedy that was never fully understood.

Years ago, a fire changed everything.
Now, the past is beginning to surface.

As Nira searches for answers, she becomes entangled in relationships filled with attraction, tension, doubt, danger, and unanswered questions. Every smile may hide a motive. Every promise may mean something more. Every choice can bring her closer to love—or to the secret behind the fire.

Who can you trust?
Who is telling the truth?
What are they hiding?
What will you choose when love and truth point in different directions?

Your Choices Matter

Every decision can:

• Unlock new scenes
• Change character relationships
• Reveal hidden clues and secrets
• Open branching paths
• Lead to different endings

Why Orbittoon?

• Watch cinematic drama scenes
• Make choices at key moments
• Experience romance and mystery together
• Shape emotional character relationships
• Follow branching narratives with multiple endings
• Guide a strong female lead in her search for the truth
• Uncover hidden motives, suspense, and dramatic twists

Orbittoon is made for viewers who enjoy interactive drama, romance games, mystery games, otome romance, dating drama, choice-based entertainment, branching narratives, emotional character drama, and cinematic episodes.

A forgotten memory.
A hidden truth.
A relationship that may change everything.

Enter Orbittoon and begin Moon Rain.
Watch. Choose. Uncover the truth.
Shape your own ending.
